DuckNotes is a free note-taking app for Windows, made for lectures: notebooks and pages like OneNote, with checklists, tables, equations, pictures, and drawings and diagrams you make with the mouse or a pen. Everything saves by itself as you type, and your notes stay on your own computer, in Documents\DuckNotes.

## Install

1. Download **DuckNotes-Setup.exe** below. That one file is all you need.
2. Run it. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC", because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Open DuckNotes from the Start menu.

It needs Windows 10 or 11. DuckNotes goes online only to check for updates.

The "Source code" files below are added by GitHub automatically; you don't need them.
